purpose: Authorial inputs for the Quoin change-assurance record. Only the projected sealed record is authoritative; top-level purpose, derived_fields and sources lookup are not sealed evidence.
not_an_envelope: Quoin's packaged change-assurance-record-v1, proof-attestation-v1, and verification-receipt-v1 schemas are the shapes. This file projects into the record body Quoin requires and derives nothing beyond the digests its own derived_fields names. It is not a local evidence envelope, it retains nothing, and it computes no verdict.
derived_fields: subject.base_revision and impact_snapshot.revision come from the candidate revision the caller names.
source_connections[].revision is the candidate revision; each sealed path-shaped source_id is required to equal its sources lookup path, and its digest is read from that exact path.
proof_obligations[].configuration_digest is read from the bytes at that proof's declared `configuration` path.
impact_snapshot.digest is read from the bytes of the Quire static export.
record.digest is computed and written by quoin at seal time; this file never states it.

Nothing else is filled in, defaulted, or discovered. A field this file does not state is a validation failure at seal time, which is the behaviour that makes the record a statement rather than a guess.

gaps: subject.scope is authorial; candidate change-footprint completeness is unverified

requirements.statement: Every declared component version and consumed artifact digest is supplied to the packaged compatibility classifier, and the repository supplies neither a local compatibility mapping nor an internal mirror registry.

The corpus conformance, corpus oracle, and feature-boundary results are structured, are produced by this repository's tools, and reach Quoin through the declared adapter without Quoin or Quire executing a producer.
Static specification, obligation, and coverage facts for a candidate revision come from the Quire export named by the sealed record's impact snapshot.
Each of the twelve verification outcomes is demonstrated by a case that produced it, and each negative case is paired with a positive control that was observed to be accepted.

No live repository source implements or names the deleted generic evidence envelope, manifest, retention store, tool-identity lock, anchor file, or aggregate verdict. Immutable review and plan records that describe the deleted subjects, the declaring test, and an inert directory marker are explicit non-live exclusions.

Every version-control-tracked non-archival path is present in the exact reviewed live-source set regardless of its name or extension; a changed per-area population is diagnosed before the exact path delta; every ordinary-untracked live path is scanned, named, and refuses a clean reviewed population; repository-authored ignored generated paths do not redefine that population; and unavailable enumeration is a typed refusal rather than an intercepted panic.

The deleted-identity scan accepts arbitrary non-UTF-8 tracked bytes, still detects an embedded forbidden ASCII identity with its path named, includes ordinary-untracked paths even when workstation or administrative Git excludes name them, and refuses untracked or index-divergent `.gitignore` policy.

Every declared shared component version and externally consumed artifact digest is classified by the packaged Engineering Assurance compatibility matrix; that matrix is bound by its exact released package/version and package integrity rather than circular self-classification, with no repository-local mapping or internal mirror substitute.

SUITE-008 identifies the exact local shared-assurance test command, and neither the change-assurance declaration nor any Quoin proof obligation claims that SUITE-008 was attested; its result is valid only for the exact-head review that reports it.

The candidate source identity covers every non-archival tracked path, refuses every ordinary-untracked live path and mutable ignore policy, and scans arbitrary tracked bytes without allowing a forbidden deleted identity to hide.
Every attested proof result is derived from a declared producer's structured bytes, with absent, empty, unreadable, or foreign-protocol input refused, and neither Quire nor Quoin executes a producer.
Pass, fail, unavailable, unsupported, inconclusive, not-computed, malformed, partial, stale, suspect, vacuous, and tampered remain distinguishable, and no non-success outcome is reported as passing.

preservation_constraints.statement: The 23 retained quire.derivation-evidence/v1 envelopes, the two schemas frozen because those envelopes named them by digest, and the compatibility fixtures are deleted outright under agent-ix/engineering-assurance#7's released preservation constraint. Not one is backdated, re-sealed, or edited to look like it still verifies, and no claim that argued from them is restated more weakly in their absence.
The MLTL AST, inclusive intervals, spans, stable identities, semantic-profile model, wire decoder, node bound, and the shared temporal conformance corpus remain owned and executed by this repository.
The published crate gains no runtime dependency on Quire or Quoin, and the default feature graph keeps zero normal dependencies and compiles without std or alloc.
Hosted CI remains workflow_dispatch only and is not dispatched by this change.

SUITE-008 is the local cargo test --test shared_assurance --all-features command. Its result belongs to the exact-head pull-request review and is not a structured producer input or Quoin proof attestation.

proof_obligations.statement: Every fixture in the shared temporal corpus replays through the real crate at this candidate revision with the manifest's declared validation outcome and declared rejection reason.

The corpus semantic oracle derives every declared horizon and closed-trace outcome from the formula and trace rather than comparing two hand-written copies, and agrees with the crate on every fixture's accept/reject identity.
The crate compiles with no default features, alloc only, serde, and all features, and the default dependency graph is empty.
The authoritative static specification, obligation, and coverage facts for this revision are the Quire export, which executes no producer.
The declared MSRV compiles every target and feature of this crate at this candidate revision, against the locked dependency graph, and reports it in cargo's own JSON message stream.

The prior gap — v0.2.0 recording accepted.state = pending_human_acceptance with the human acceptance landing only on main (agent-ix/engineering-assurance#20) — no longer applies to the pin this repository carries.
unknowns.resolution: engineering-assurance pin moved v0.2.0 -> v0.2.1 (agent-ix/engineering-assurance#47), whose packaged matrix records accepted.state = accepted with accepted_by and accepted_at.

unknowns.statement: No ix-flow decision event exists for this change. Only the repository owner may create one, and none was synthesized, so the receipt is expected to read incomplete with a missing decision rather than complete.

At base 4cb5787 an invalid Rust item made ordinary make ci stop at fmt-check and exit 2; make -k ci classified eight paths as failed or unmade, while the other five were unaffected by that compile fault and were not measured under their own faults. With global .IGNORE:, the same eight paths emitted ignored failures, Make treated all thirteen prerequisites as successful, and make ci exited 0. Quoin constrains producer bytes only when a record is actually produced; this chain retains nothing locally, and under .IGNORE: its own refusal was suppressed and no record was produced. The owner accepts only this measured spelling for pre-stable development and must re-evaluate the deviation before the first stable release candidate; seventeen other spellings and use-specific qualification remain open under agent-ix/engineering-assurance#11.

No active qualified record is claimed for pre-stable development. Before the first stable release candidate, the tl-syntax release owner must re-apply the preservation constraint, re-evaluate the Make execution-control limitation, and require a current qualified record under agent-ix/engineering-assurance#11.
